source: Made by ffmpeg 8.1.3 on 13-10-2026: testsrc2 at 160x96, 12 frames, h264: -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -bf 0 -g 6 -x264-params aud=1 -f h264; hevc: -c:v libx265 -preset ultrafast -x265-params aud=1:bframes=0:keyint=6:log-level=error -f hevc. Samples split at the access unit delimiters; sha256 of the pictures (yuv420p, frame after frame) as that ffmpeg decodes them.
